topics.title: Pinocchio Shooting & Temple Attack
topics.summary: Deborah discusses an incident where shots were fired near Pinocchio and a group of young men attacked Jewish students after leaving a fraternity party; police suspect racial bias due to the victims' religious identity while Howard reflects on longstanding patterns of violence within disadvantaged communities.

topics.title: Teenage Death & Parental Cover-Up
topics.summary: A fifteen-year-old girl was fatally struck by a car while crossing Route 110. The driver, her father—a former motorcycle cop—attempted to destroy evidence and evade authorities after the incident, raising concerns about parental responsibility and concealment efforts.

topics.title: Lindhurst High Football Initiation Scandal
topics.summary: Following a disturbing initiation ritual involving assault at Lindhurst High School’s football camp, two players were suspended and faced controversy after new recruits were subjected to acts of violence including sodomy. The incident sparked outrage among parents and raised concerns about accountability within the school community.

topics.title: Hair Replacement & Naked Performance at China Club
topics.summary: During a radio show segment, host Howard Stern discusses hair replacement options and then transitions to an impromptu performance featuring guests dressed in revealing attire at the China Club. Guests engage in suggestive behavior while discussing personal fantasies and attempting to entertain Stern.

topics.title: Stern’s Unconventional Morning with Strippers
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard engages in increasingly bizarre behavior involving Luna from East Africa and Megan, culminating in them taking their pants off. The conversation veers into discussions of sexual fantasies, personal struggles with relationships, and an apparent desire to exploit the situation for entertainment value.”} 29 words

topics.title: Stern’s Fantasies & Houston Prostitution
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses bizarre fantasies involving multiple women, referencing Tarzan and African names. He recounts meeting American men at the China Club and details Pedro Guerrero's experience with Houston prostitutes who allegedly drugged him and stole jewelry during a hotel encounter.
